author: Ghost Developer Studio
description: Prepare a pitch to {{creator}} by drafting first, checking every fact, and sending only after approval, in the approved text, with no changes at send time. The product to lead with is {{product}}.

inputs.description: Creator name and handle, verified from their own profile.
inputs.name: creator

inputs.description: The one product to lead with.
inputs.name: product

name: Creator Pitch, Draft First
notes: Draft first, always. No paid offer, rate, or spend is promised without a separate approval.

steps.detail: Check the handle, follower count, and niche from the creator's own profile on the day of the pitch. Do not use old crawl numbers.
steps.title: Verify the creator

steps.detail: Lead with {{product}}, the one product that fits this audience. Keep any second product as a follow-up point only.
steps.title: Pick one lead product

steps.detail: Write a short pitch in plain words. No em dashes. No invented numbers. Every claim must come from a real, checked result.
steps.gate: No em dashes in any copy that will be posted or sent.
steps.title: Draft the pitch

steps.detail: Do not send anything until the draft is approved as written. If the text changes, get approval for the new text.
steps.title: Wait for approval

steps.detail: Send the approved text exactly as approved. Confirm it appears in the thread after sending.
steps.title: Send the approved text only

steps.detail: Check for a reply on the agreed schedule. Draft any follow-up for approval. Never send a follow-up without approval.
steps.title: Watch for a reply
